calibrated_on.method: QA-1 §4.1 (v1.3.2): τ_flag 预注册网格 25 档 {0.05..0.95, 0.96..0.999}，可行域 dev-FPR<=0.4% & dev-chmirror-FPR<=0.08%，argmax recall 并列取保守；τ_strong = max(dev真阳q10, τ_flag+0.05)；τ_ood = dev负例距离q99.5

notes: QA 独立选点（交叉验证 deveng calib.json 推荐点用）；detail={'T1': 'NO-FEASIBLE-POINT', 'T2': 'OK', 'T3': 'OK', 'T4': 'OK', 'T5': 'OK', 'T6': 'OK'}；score 域无可行任务继承 calib logit 域阈值: ['T1']（score 饱和致网格失效，logit 域为忠实替代）
